newsitem.title: USA: CONAGRA, ZENECA UNITS FORM SOUTH AFRICA VENTURE.
newsitem.headline: CONAGRA, ZENECA UNITS FORM SOUTH AFRICA VENTURE.

text.p: United Agri Products, a unit of food company ConAgra Inc , said Thursday it has formed a joint venture company in the Cape region of South Africa with Zeneca Agrochemicals, a unit of Zeneca Group Plc .
The new venture, UAP Crop Care, will specialize in serving the agricultural chemical needs of the fruit, grape and grain farmers in the region, the company said.
"This initial investment in the South African market is a strategic step in our aggressive plan for continued international growth," J. Charles Blue, president of United Agri Products, said.
